mapper.insert: insert into sys_message ( message_num ,message_type_cd ,message_text_ko ,message_text_en ,message_text_zh ,message_text_ja ,message_text_ot ,remark ,create_date ,create_by ) select p.prefix || to_char(nvl((select max(to_number(substr(sm.message_num,length(p.prefix) + 1))) from sys_message sm where regexp_like(sm.message_num,'^' || p.prefix || '[0-9]+$')),9999) + 1) ,#{message_type_cd} ,#{message_text_ko} ,#{message_text_en,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ,#{message_text_zh,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ,#{message_text_ja,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ,#{message_text_ot,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ,#{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ,sysdate ,#{user_id} from ( select #{message_class_cd} || '-' || case #{message_type_cd} when 'A' then 'ALT' when 'C' then 'CNF' when 'I' then 'INF' when 'E' then 'ERR' when 'W' then 'WRN' end || '-' as prefix from dual where #{message_class_cd} in ('NM','JM') and #{message_type_cd} in ('A','C','I','E','W') ) p
